_note: Configurable weather thresholds. Defaults are illustrative engineering choices; heavy-rain bands follow India Meteorological Department 24-hour rainfall categories. These are NOT universally valid crop-damage thresholds.

HEAT_STRESS.description: Forecast maximum temperature at or above threshold on consecutive days.

DRY_SPELL.description: Consecutive recent days with daily precipitation below threshold.

HEAVY_RAIN.description: Forecast daily precipitation at or above threshold.
